content: WordPiece tokens BIBREF14 are sub-word units obtained by applying a greedy segmentation algorithm to the training corpus: a desired number (say, $D$) of WordPieces are chosen such that the segmented corpus is minimal in the number of WordPieces used. A cursory look at both vocabularies reveals that $93.9\%$ of the WordPieces in the student vocabulary also exist in the teacher vocabulary, suggesting room for a reduction in the WordPiece vocabulary size from 30K tokens.
